A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A.1–A.4. Content can be matched across the table restructuring and figure relocation.

before.justification: v2 reports original automatic and human evaluations of timeline summaries, representation analyses, and a teacher-model evaluation reporting a 0.07 F1 improvement in Appendix A.2.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and adds automatic evaluation results for two teacher-distillation controls in Table 2.

M1.justification: NarrativeReason construction, teacher fine-tuning, frozen-teacher distillation and simultaneous student timeline training remain unchanged, including the NST, PRT and CRD objectives. The new distillation variants serve as experimental controls.

E1.justification: Both versions use NarrativeReason, the 5,000-example Wikipedia-derived timeline training dataset, TalkLife mental-health timelines and TEMPREASON L3 in Appendix A.2. The new teacher controls reuse existing data without adding a task, domain or evaluation scenario.

E2.justification: v3 adds KDtimeline and KDorigin to the automatic comparison in Table 2, using a timeline-trained and an untuned LLaMA teacher, respectively. All earlier comparators remain across v3 Tables 1–2.

E3.justification: The added controls vary teacher training while retaining a LLaMA teacher, Phi student, NST+PRT transfer and timeline student training. Existing metrics and human-evaluation procedures remain. Table 2 lists fine-tuning data for Phi_ICL despite Section 4.2 retaining its in-context-learning description, so an actual training change for that baseline is unresolved.

E4.justification: New teacher-training ablations test whether gains specifically depend on temporal-reasoning training. Existing KD-strategy analyses and Appendix A.4 examples remain. Section 5.1 reattributes the representation analysis from Phi_tl to L-Phi, but visually matching plots and Figure 3's retained Phi_tl title do not establish a new probing experiment.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests for its results. The added control scores follow the existing point-estimate reporting practice without introducing uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: v3 Table 2 adds FC/EA scores of 0.330/0.965 for KDtimeline and 0.332/0.967 for KDorigin, below the retained L-Phi NST+PRT scores of 0.424/0.971. Previously tabulated automatic and human scores, Appendix A.2's 0.07 F1 improvement, and Appendix A.4 examples are unchanged.

T1.justification: The PRT probability and KL-divergence definitions, NST MMD objective, and CRD loss and sampling formulation retain the same mathematical content. No new formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: NarrativeReason, temporal knowledge distillation, improved out-of-domain mental-health summarisation, reduced hallucination and better representations. The added controls provide evidence for retained claims rather than redefining them.

C2.justification: Section 5 adds the hypothesis that NST/PRT distribution matching better preserves temporal coherence than CRD's instance separation. It also interprets the new controls as evidence for temporal reasoning's specific benefit. The stated clinical limitations, diagnostic-overconfidence concerns and applicability cautions remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix A.3 newly supplies the temporal-task prompt and clarifies the timeline placeholder for the existing joint-training setup. Table 2 documents teacher/student configurations. Appendix A.1 hyperparameters remain unchanged, while v2's footnote stating that annotations were obtained directly from the authors of Song et al. (2024) is removed.

R1.justification: Related-work coverage, substantive research positioning and the reference list remain unchanged. Appendix A.2 repairs the broken TEMPREASON citation using Tan et al. (2023), which was already cited elsewhere; this does not introduce another cited work.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited terminology and grammar edits, expands evaluation and results explanations, changes Section 5.1's model references to L-Phi, expands one author's name and adds acknowledgments. Section order and most prose, including limitations and appendix examples, remain intact.

P2.justification: The automatic results are reorganized into a KD-strategy table and a comparison table with configuration columns; the human table is renumbered. Figure 3's panels change from vertical to side-by-side placement, and Figures 3–4 are enlarged and relocated. Captions and the CKA legend change model labels while retaining the plotted patterns.

improvement.justification: The new teacher controls address a missing comparison in v2 and better support attributing benefits specifically to temporal-reasoning training. Appendix A.3 also makes the joint-training prompt more reproducible. These are useful but limited gains, with reporting ambiguities remaining in Figure 3's model labels and Table 2's Phi_ICL fine-tuning entry.
